text:
nina-peopleops: Heads-up: Omar submitted a promotion for Ana (EM->Sr EM) but the effective date in Lattice is 2026-04-01; manager wants 2026-04-15 because of project milestone. Payroll cutoff is 2026-04-14. Can we do retro if paperwork misses cutoff?

omar-eng-manager: yes we want 4/15. I accidentally clicked 4/01 in the approval flow. I can re-email signed note. What's the fastest route?

lee-hr: quickest is: manager email with explicit effective date, attach Lattice approval screenshot, open payroll ticket before cutoff, comp director approves retro if needed. For retro <= payroll cutoff we can include in current month if ticket + docs arrive before cutoff.

ana-payroll: small correction: cutoff 2026-04-14 23:59 UTC, next payroll run 2026-04-20 18:00 UTC. If ticket after cutoff we process in next run as a manual adjustment. Tax treatment depends on employee country.

omar-eng-manager: Ana is US-based. Also curious: will this change affect her existing RSU schedule?

lee-hr: promo doesn't re-date previous grants. StockOps issues any promo grant separately as augmentation. I'll cc StockOps when you send the promo email.

stockops-bot: Reminder: provide EMPID and attach grant docs when requesting augmentation. Augmentation grant will have its own grant date and not change original cliff.

an a-payroll: example retro calc we use (rounded): (new_salary - old_salary) / 365 * prorated_days. We'll post exact cents in ticket.

omar-eng-manager: ok emailing signed note now and opening ticket PAY-2026-5010. Tagging @lee-hr and @ana-payroll.

lee-hr: Received. Comp director approved retro inclusion at 11:40 UTC. Payroll confirmed PAY-2026-5010 will include retro in April run. Closing thread; I'll update the internal checklist with "double-check effective date before final approval".
